title: BliQ Messaging Platform
description: Enterprise multi-tenant communications platform supporting SMS, WhatsApp, VoIP, real-time chat, broadcast campaigns, contact synchronization, billing, and usage management. Contributed across messaging workflows, authentication, billing, Google Contacts synchronization, WebSocket events, broadcast processing, and VoIP configuration. Improved large-volume messaging workflows using queue-based processing, batching, and database-query optimization.

title: Techflu - Tech Rental Platform (B2B & B2C)
description: Production B2B and B2C technology rental platform with inventory reservations, bookings, recurring payments, KYC, order management, and delivery workflows. Developed backend and full-stack features for inventory, Razorpay AutoPay, order processing, KYC approvals, delivery operations, discounts, and promo codes. Used Redis, BullMQ, and scheduled jobs to support reliable asynchronous rental workflows.

title: Reusable Multi-Tenant Identity Platform (IDP)
description: Designed a reusable multi-tenant identity provider supporting JWT authentication, OTP login, Google OAuth, role-based access control, and tenant isolation. Built centralized authentication APIs and user-management workflows with secure token handling and authorization boundaries for SaaS applications.

title: Self-Hosted Home Server Platform
description: Built a personal self-hosted cloud environment for deploying full-stack applications and backend services. Implemented Docker-based deployments, Nginx reverse-proxy routing, Cloudflare secure public access, MinIO S3-compatible object storage, and environment/secret management to practice production-style infrastructure workflows.

title: Cloudverse - Cloud Management & FinOps Platform
description: Contributed to a cloud management and FinOps platform by developing backend workflows for enterprise cloud cost allocation and financial analytics. Worked on pool-based cost allocation, direct and shared cost distribution, Reserved Instance and Savings Plan allocations, ledger-based tracking, and scheduled cost-processing workflows.

title: Realm - Real Estate Mobile Application
description: Developed a cross-platform real-estate application for Android and iOS with property discovery, property details, authentication, API integrations, and appointment-booking workflows. Worked on mobile UI flows and production deployment using Ionic Capacitor.

title: Portfolio Website
description: Responsive developer portfolio built with React, Tailwind CSS, animations, lazy loading, SEO metadata, project filtering, and a contact experience designed to showcase production engineering work.
